body.sub: How Animals Survive in the Arctic
lines: Their black skin absorbs the sun's heat.
Their thick layer of fat keeps them warm.
Their outer hair protects them from cold wind.
The air stays warm because of their body heat.
Lemmings make burrows under the snow.
The snow protects the burrows from the cold.
They put fur, feathers, or grass inside.
ko: 그들의 두꺼운 지방층이 그들을 따뜻하게 해 준다.
그들의 바깥 털은 찬 바람으로부터 그들을 보호한다.
그 공기는 그들의 체온 때문에 따뜻하게 유지된다.
그들은 안에 털, 깃털, 또는 풀을 넣는다.
body.text: Polar bears have black skin. Their black skin absorbs the sun's heat. Their thick layer of fat keeps them warm. Their outer hair protects them from cold wind. Their inner hair traps air. The air stays warm because of their body heat. Lemmings make burrows under the snow. The snow protects the burrows from the cold. They put fur, feathers, or grass inside. They stay warm there.
